cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team. You will use analytic and technical skills to build and maintain data solutions and capabilities that address business problems.
On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Innovation
Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives
Business Intelligence
Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies
Data Management
Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's Degree plus at least 5 years of experience in data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master's Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date
Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 1 year of experience in at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience in querying, analyzing, and working with data languages and platforms
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Preferred Requirements
Master's Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
Scripting experience in Python, R, Spark, and SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will regularly work with analytic and technical skills to build and maintain data solutions and capabilities that address business problems, staying in close contact with business and tech teams throughout.
On any given day you will be engaged across three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Innovation
Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Explore and quickly grasp new technologies to move varied initiatives forward
Business Intelligence
Work closely with the business on a regular basis to provide consultancy, clarify business needs, and translate them into tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Conduct analysis and communicate meaningful insights on business strategies, walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions
Data Management
Actively promote understanding and adherence to data quality management principles including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Connect regularly with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality
cond_0321.requirements:
Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in Python, R, Spark, and SQL
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's Degree plus at least 5 years of experience in data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master's Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience in at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience in querying and analyzing and working with data languages and platforms
Master's Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)
cond_0321.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:
Innovation
Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives
Business Intelligence
Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies
Data Management
Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality
cond_0425.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics discipline required; Master's degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in scripting languages including Python, R, Spark, and SQL.
Proven track record working with data in various forms, including data warehouses/SQL and unstructured data.
Deep knowledge of AWS services, with substantial experience utilizing and developing within the platform.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in data analytics with a Bachelor's degree, or a Master's degree with relevant experience; required degree must be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of proven proficiency in at least one scripting language.
At least 1 year of solid, hands-on experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool.
At least 1 year of demonstrated expertise in querying, analyzing, and working with data languages and platforms.
Advanced knowledge of Python, R, Spark, or SQL, with at least 2 years of coding experience.
At least 2 years of significant experience working within process management and improvement methodologies such as Agile, Lean, or Six Sigma.
At least 1 year of demonstrated expertise utilizing and developing within AWS services.
At least 1 year of deep knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts, and data quality tools (e.g., Informatica DQ).
cond_0425.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

The work falls across three areas – Innovation, Business Intelligence, and Data Management.

At least 1 year of experience in querying and analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

The work falls into three areas — Innovation, Business Intelligence, and Data Management.
cond_0637.responsibilities:
Innovation
Use open source and digital technologies to mine complex, high-volume data from varied sources and platforms
Build data solutions, tools, and capabilities that support self-service frameworks for data consumers
Explore and learn new technologies as needed to move initiatives forward
Business Intelligence
Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate business needs into tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for data visualization and insight
Conduct analysis that produces meaningful findings on business strategies
Data Management
Apply and support data quality management principles, including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Coordinate with relevant Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and run tools to monitor and report on data quality
cond_0637.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics discipline, plus at least 5 years of experience in data analytics; or a Master's degree in a STEM discipline (degree must be obtained by the scheduled start date)
At least 1 year of experience in at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience querying and analyzing data using data languages and platforms
At least 1 year of experience with a business intelligence visualization tool
Experience with data in various forms, including data warehouses, SQL, and unstructured data
Preferred Requirements
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 2 years of experience working within process management or improvement methodologies such as Agile, Lean, or Six Sigma
At least 1 year of experience with data governance, data quality management concepts, and data quality tools (e.g., Informatica DQ)
[Company name masked] will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.
